relationships.subject: Nav1.6
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, these results support a significant role for NaV1.6 in phrenic nerve signaling and respiratory function.

relationships.subject: SSCI-6
relationships.evidence_quote: SSCI-6 is in the same structural class as SSCI-3 and inhibits NaV1.6 channels with a calculated IC50 of 0.023 μM in in vitro electrophysiology experiments

relationships.subject: Nav1.6
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibitors lacking sufficient NaV1.7 selectivity over NaV1.6 were associated with respiratory cessation after in vivo administration to rodents.

key_findings: Aryl-sulfonamide Nav1.7 inhibitors with insufficient selectivity over Nav1.6 caused respiratory cessation in rats, blocked phrenic nerve signaling and diaphragm contraction.
Respiratory effects tracked Nav1.6 potency rather than Nav1.7 potency.
